mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_session (id, title, workspace, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{workspace}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_session SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_session SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND (title IS NULL OR title LIKE 'Chat %')
UPDATE chat_session SET workspace = #{workspace}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
